premises.p3:
# Pre-registration — intermediate-size bracket check (frozen before any patch data, 2026-09-24)
Hypothesis (from the 19-qubit oracle, report §5): at the tracker's Floquet parameters, truncated Pauli-path (delta=1e-4)
is at or below the exact value and truncated MPS (chi=64) at or above it, for mag / zzd2 / zzd3.
Test: patches of the tracker's own 51-qubit lattice, n in {27, 33} (BFS ball about the minimum-eccentricity qubit, the
tracker's own edge layers), cycles {1, 2, 4, 8, 13, 16}; truth = BlueQubit statevector (device=cpu).
Counting rule (as at 19q): a point is "in bracket" if pp_1e-4 - 0.005 <= exact <= mps_64 + 0.005; "two-sided" if
pp_1e-4 > 0.005. Report counts in / total, and two-sided in / two-sided total, per n, whichever way they fall.
Supported if >= 95% of points are in bracket at each n; falsified otherwise. Also reported (descriptive, not tested):
MPS excess over exact at chi 64 vs 256 (the tightening rate).
No re-running with other parameters to rescue the hypothesis.

Result at 33 qubits: 15 points have an exact value and all of them are in the bracket; 3 points are missing because BlueQubit terminated the jobs.

# Pre-registration addendum — bracket at 27 cycles (frozen before any data, 2026-09-24)
Purpose: the 74qx27c tracker candidate runs 27 cycles; our bracket was validated only to 16 cycles (PATCH_PREREG.md,
hash ad33761e…). Same hypothesis, counting rule and success threshold as PATCH_PREREG.md, applied to:
patches n in {27, 33} (same BFS patches of the tracker's own 51q lattice and its edge layers), cycles {20, 27},
observables {mag, zzd2, zzd3}; truth = BlueQubit statevector (device=cpu); Pauli-path delta 1e-3, 1e-4; MPS chi 64, 256.
Supported if >= 95% of points are in bracket at each n; falsified otherwise. Server-terminated jobs: at most 2 retries,
then reported as missing. No other parameters will be tried to rescue the hypothesis.
Only if supported at both n will the 74qx27c bracket (run 2) be reported as "consistent with / inconsistent with"
QESEM; otherwise it is reported as raw values with no bracket interpretation.
